newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-VALENCIA VICTORY OVER BESIKTAS IS BOOST FOR ARAGONES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-VALENCIA VICTORY OVER BESIKTAS IS BOOST FOR ARAGONES.

text.p: Beleaguered Valencia manager Luis Aragones received a big boost on Tuesday when his side beat Turkey's Besiktas 3-1 in the first leg of their UEFA Cup third-round match.
Valencia were lucky not to go behind after 16 minutes when Besiktas's Nigerian striker Daniel Amokachi missed the simplest of chances.
But moments later the Spanish side went ahead through Goran Vlaovic, who climbed acrobatically to flick home a cross.
Six minutes later the Turks were troubled by another cross and the ball ended up in the net after a mix-up between Ali Gancur and goalkeeper Marijan Mrmic, with Gancur conceding an own goal.
Besiktas began to look better in attack and Oktay Derelioglu reduced the arrears in the 33rd minute.

But it was uphill all the way for the visitors after the 38th minute when Sinan Demircioglu was sent off after picking up his second yellow card. Valencia had several opportunities to increase their lead before Francisco Ferreira made it 3-1 eight minutes from time.
